verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's docs reference including external/multiple calendars in availability checks and budgeting time via calendar events, implying busy blocks from connected calendars feed into scheduling, but no evidence explicitly describes connecting a personal AND work calendar and syncing busy blocks automatically between them for an individual user's own scheduling link. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-calendar (work+personal) connection and automatic busy-block sync for a single user, plus independent/hands-on confirmation.
